origin: From the Japanese kanban (看板, signboard). Toyota's production system managed the flow of work with cards, and the method moved over to managing software work.
whenToUse: Managing work that flows through states such as to do, in progress, and done.
whenNotToUse: There are only two states (use a checklist).
Small screens (use a list split into status tabs).
There are hundreds of cards (use a table or a filtered list).

alternatives.name: Selectable Table
alternatives.reason: Changing the status of many items at once.

accessibility: Each card has "Move to …" buttons that do the same as dragging.
Announce the result of a move with role="status".
Columns are sections with a name and a card count.
The column to drop into is marked with a border and background.
